notes: People get sick. Colds, the flu and stomach bugs come on gradually (a scratchy throat a day before), get worse, peak and fade over several days, and they spread: spend time near someone contagious and you, or anyone else around, might catch it a day later. Winter and getting soaked in the cold raise the odds. Afterwards people are immune for a few weeks.
Eating food that has gone bad can give you food poisoning a few hours later.

Anyone badly sick (flu, stomach bug, food poisoning) stays home in bed instead of following their schedule. Cold medicine, cough syrup and painkillers from the pharmacy help, and hangovers already hit the morning after a heavy night. Injuries keep healing day by day as before.
